title: AI Dev. Mixed Reality Shooter 100% Vibe Code
author: No_Coast_1953
selftext:
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K21PiyynM5g](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K21PiyynM5g)

My first game, completely vibe coded with ChatGPT and then Bezi.

I've never made a video game and haven't coded since MySpace but I have always wanted this type of video game in my life.  

I used ChatGPT in April at first. Got to a great point but the scripts became overwhelming for Chat.  I have no idea what I'm doing along so we had to stop dev.  I was considering finding a partner with experience.

Then BEZI released and I'm fully back to fixing bugs, performance and adding features. It's like having that partner.

The game is in the Meta store (technically making me the 1st AI Vibe Code game dev for AR/MR) if you would like to check out the current state, before I send the new updates which should improve things greatly.

comments.author: hugobart
comments.body: can you give more information please? tech stack used, models, engine, recommendations for other vibedevs? :)

replies.author: No_Coast_1953
replies.body:
I can try to answer some that. I'm using Unity. Originally 6.0 but I just updated to 6.2 for this project. 

1st [https://www.bezi.com/](https://www.bezi.com/) is game changing.  I didn't use this at first cause I didn't know about it.  Now it's making everything crazy easy.  I don't even copy/paste anymore, it's pretty absurd. 

2nd. I found out too late but Meta has great Building Blocks that are basically one-click systems. Check those out before you build anything. 

This is the framework for my FPS system [https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/templates/systems/vr-fps-kit-framework-template-270649](https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/templates/systems/vr-fps-kit-framework-template-270649)

AI is  Blaze AI

[https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/tools/behavior-ai/blaze-ai-engine-194525](https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/tools/behavior-ai/blaze-ai-engine-194525)

these are current models

[https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/3d/characters/humanoids/humans/low-poly-soldiers-224153](https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/3d/characters/humanoids/humans/low-poly-soldiers-224153)
